sourceTitle: Portsmouth: 6. SCHOOL CONSTRUCTION AND RENOVATION PROJECTS
exactQuestion: Shall an act, passed at the 2026 session of the General Assembly, entitled “An Act authorizing the Town of Portsmouth to issue not to exceed $41,000,000 general obligation bonds, notes, and other evidences of indebtedness to finance the construction, additions, renovation, improvement, alteration, repair, furnishing, and equipping of schools and school facilities throughout the Town" be approved?
officialStatement: If approved, the Town shall borrow an amount not to exceed $41,000,000 for the above school projects. All school projects included in the Necessity of School Construction Stage II application approved by the Council on Elementary and Secondary Education and funded by the bond will be eligible for a minimum of 35% Housing Aid Reimbursement.

sourceTitle: Portsmouth: 7. NON-PARTISAN TOWN COUNCIL AND SCHOOL COMMITTEE ELECTIONS
exactQuestion: Shall the offices of Town Council and School Committee be non-partisan? (Amends Art. II, Sec. 201 and Art. VII, Sec 701)
officialStatement: If approved, Article II, Section 201, and Article VII, Section 701, of the Portsmouth Town Charter will be amended to identify the offices of Town Council and School Committee as “non-partisan”, to remove party designations from the ballot, and to add text for a candidate placement lottery for School Committee candidates.
